snippet.title: TEMPLE MAKER 64 Announcement Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
Build dungeons full of traps and puzzles, or grab your sword and explore community-made dungeons. Choose from a vast selection of items, monsters, puzzle elements, and bosses, all wrapped up in an N64-inspired love letter.

Check out the game on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3897090/Temple_Maker_64/

Support the game on Kickstarter! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/akelamorse/temple-maker-64
